breakdown.description: The varying traction is extended from the outer right edge to additional cutout surfaces selected by outward-normal orientation
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth clarifies that traction should be applied *only* to the outer right edge (x=1). The agent, however, repeated the user's incorrect and contradictory instruction by including the line: 'Apply this varying traction only to boundary segments with an outward normal having a positive x-component.' This incorrectly expands the traction application to the inner cutout, which the ground truth explicitly states should be traction-free.
